title: Stored revision registry
responsibility: Projects a revision’s declared units and scenarios into a compact, revision-bound registry with exact declared dependency and scenario coverage edges, scenario test catalog metadata, version identities and reviewed limits. It does not scan source or return source bytes.

inputs.name: revisionRegistry.manifests
inputs.description: Unit manifests stored at the revision; entries are sorted by id without filtering status.

inputs.name: revisionRegistry.scenarios
inputs.description: Scenario manifests stored at the revision; entries are sorted by id.

inputs.name: revisionRegistry.blobs
inputs.description: Optional owned-file path to blob-hash map, default empty; absent files contribute an explicit absent marker to unit version digests.

inputs.name: revisionRegistry.baselines
inputs.description: Optional reviewed budget baseline map by unit, default empty; selected emitted/frozen limits are included when present.

outputs.name: revisionRegistry
outputs.description: Returns {available:boolean; gap?:string; units:Array<unit view>; scenarios:Array<scenario view>; graph:{nodes:Array<{id:string;kind:"unit"|"scenario"}>;edges:Array<{from:string;to:string;via:string}>}}. Units are sorted by id and include id/kind/status/title/responsibility, optional composition, group, helper, catalog/config/preview/documentation/limit fields, declared dependencies reduced to {unit,via}, scenario ids, owns, contract inputs/outputs/errors, runtime {kind,targets:{kind,entry}[]}, budgets and a 16-character version digest. Scenarios are sorted by id and include id/title/kind/units, reduced states, viewports, tests reduced strictly to {id,kind,runner}, and reduced evidence. scenario.tests carries no file paths. Although units may have optional testFiles and serviceConsumers fields through UnitMetadata aliases, this function does not populate them; no per-unit test paths or runtime consumer lists are available from this output. graph edges are declared unit dependencies plus scenario coverage edges. available is false with a gap when there are no units. The function uses committed manifest/scenario data and supplied blob hashes only; it does not scan source or include source bytes.
